briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 launch intensifies AGI race as China accelerates domestic frontier models

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI frontier remains highly competitive with new model releases from major labs driving capability gains. US export controls continue to shape global access while safety concerns mount around autonomous agents.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with advanced tool-use and multi-agent orchestration. Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus and Google's Gemini 3 Ultra both launched in the past week, while DeepSeek-V4 and xAI's Grok-3 closed capability gaps.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. Regulators in the EU and US are advancing mandatory red-teaming requirements for frontier models.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA announced Blackwell Ultra ramp with TSMC securing additional 3nm capacity. Microsoft and Google both broke ground on new 5GW AI data center campuses in Texas and Arizona.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the next 12 months see the first publicly demonstrated autonomous AI agent capable of sustained real-world task completion without human oversight?
